answer: Identity-bond natural decay stops fake identities. Each agent locks a bond worth twice its 30-day expected earnings; it decays 5% each epoch unless renewed by verified work, so idle identities fade. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bonds plus top-ups no fake fleet recovers. An honest agent pays once, renews through service, and keeps undiluted rewards, unlike pigment on velvet unrenewed, which fades; the fable of free identities collapses.
